title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 11:53:50 最新章节：第54章尽仇定计釜底抽薪
content_zh:
大魏中叶，承平假象崩碎，盛世底色尽褪。立国百载的巍巍王朝，终究逃不过治乱循环的宿命，陷入千古朝堂最凶险的困局。皇权垂垂疲弱，天子困于深宫，徒有九五虚名，无掌乾坤之实。朝外藩镇割据坐大，各镇节度使拥兵自重、私蓄甲兵，税赋自专、法令自定，阳奉朝廷之名，阴行割据之实，疆土碎裂，号令难出帝都。朝内外戚结党营私，宦官擅权乱政，两派势力相互倾轧、轮番专权，朝堂之上正气湮灭，奸佞横行，忠良蒙冤，吏治崩坏数十年。更有江湖秘势潜行朝野，暗处势力勾连藩镇、依附权奸，以武林暗流裹挟朝堂政局，正邪界限模糊，公私恩怨纠缠家国大义，天下汹汹，四海动荡，黎民深陷水火，大魏江山风雨飘摇，岌岌可危。
乱世沉沉，庙堂朽坏，世族趋炎附势，官僚苟且偷安，手握权柄者皆为一己私利奔波，无人念及社稷苍生。当朝堂无人扶危、权贵无人尽忠之时，江山存续的希望，便落在了草泽布衣之间。陈尽仇、花无艳、包不同、铁寻柳四人，本是山野散人、江湖布衣，无世家荫蔽，无官身权责，无朝堂根基，却因缘际会，于乱世浊流中聚首，以布衣之身担社稷之重，以江湖侠骨扶将倾大厦，从蒙冤入局、绝境求生，到破局治乱、安邦定魏，最终扫尽叛烟、镇御外寇，清定乱世乾坤，而后各归本心、隐于尘嚣，成就一段藏龙隐世、覆虎安邦的无双传奇。
陈尽仇者，是乱世催生出的孤绝刃，是浊世立身的铁血臣。其名尽仇，非是嗜杀记恨、执念私怨，而是立誓尽扫天下冤仇、荡尽世间不平。他本是江湖孤客，一身傲骨、半生漂泊，无心朝堂纷争，不求功名富贵，唯愿江湖逍遥、本心安稳。可乱世无闲人，苍生无安土，朝堂奸佞构陷忠良，藩镇屠戮百姓，江湖恶势助纣为虐，无数冤屈沉埋世间。他因一桩惊天冤案被裹挟入局，亲友蒙难、自身涉险，从此挣脱江湖闲散，执刀入世。其人沉冷寡言，心性坚韧如铁，见惯朝堂虚伪、人心诡诈，却始终心怀家国赤诚。他行事凌厉果决，杀伐有度、善恶分明，对奸邪叛党从不姑息，对黎民苍生常怀悲悯。于藩镇叛乱之时，他策马平乱，冲锋陷阵破敌营；于权奸乱政之际，他逆势而行，拔刀斩佞清朝堂。一身风雪皆为家国，半生杀伐皆为苍生，以孤绝之姿，破乱世迷局，以尽仇之志，洗大魏沉冤。
花无艳，则是乱世浮沉中的一泓清潭，浊世喧嚣里的一缕清风。世人观其名，多以为艳绝风华、张扬于世，殊不知无艳二字，是其看透浮华、不染尘嚣的本心写照。她精通谋略、洞悉人心，深谙朝堂博弈之术、江湖周旋之道，却素来淡泊名利、不喜纷争。乱世朝堂，人人汲汲营营，争权夺势、攀附权贵，江湖众生，纷纷趋利避害、随波逐流，唯独花无艳，守得一身澄澈，看得透局势利弊，辨得清人心真伪。四人同行，她是破局的智眼，是迷途的明灯。无数次绝境困局，皆是她运筹帷幄、巧思破局；无数次朝堂诡辩、势力制衡，皆是她从容周旋、化解危局。她无凌厉杀伐之姿，却以智谋温柔为刃，化解刀兵、平息纷争；她无强势凌厉之态，却以通透从容之心，稳住人心、笃定前路。于乱象丛生之际，她以智安局、以善渡人，抚平乱世戾气，调和四人歧见，为铁血平乱之路，留存一份温润与清明。
包不同，是乱世之中最难得的清醒人，是腐朽朝堂的一柄诤言利刃。他生性桀骜不羁、不随流俗，一生不肯盲从、不肯附势，口头禅“非也”贯行始终，看似轻狂执拗、爱驳众议，实则是看透世俗虚伪、坚守正道本心。当世之时，朝堂文武多是趋炎附势之辈，明知政令偏颇、权奸误国，却皆缄口不言、明哲保身；江湖众人多是随波逐流之徒，眼见善恶颠倒、黑白混淆，却皆隐忍退让、苟且偷安。唯有包不同，不畏权贵、不惧人言，遇事敢辩、遇错敢斥，揭穿朝堂伪善面具，驳斥世俗迂腐偏见。他看似玩世不恭、散漫无状，骨子里却藏着最纯粹的忠义与最刚正的风骨。他不屑世俗规矩，是因规矩多为权贵所设、束缚良善；他不愿随众附和，是因众人多为苟且之徒、失却本心。在四人平乱安邦的路上，他以诤言破蒙蔽，以傲骨抗强权，不避祸、不贪功，以一身不同俗流的风骨，守住了乱世之中最难得的公道与本心。
铁寻柳，是风雨乱世里的磐石壁垒，是安邦定局的无声脊梁。其名铁寻柳，铁是铁骨铮铮、百折不屈，寻是寻道守心、矢志不渝，柳是柔韧包容、坚守初心。他不如陈尽仇凌厉耀眼，不如花无艳智计超群，不如包不同特立独行，却是四人之中最沉稳、最可靠的存在。他性情敦厚隐忍、沉静务实，不善言辞、不喜张扬，一生行事，不求声名显赫，不求世人称颂，唯求俯仰无愧、家国永安。乱世征战，前路凶险莫测，刀枪无眼、风波不息，每一次冲锋陷阵、每一次绝境断后，皆有铁寻柳的身影。他镇守后路、稳固根基，默默扛下所有危难与风雨，护住同伴、护住苍生、护住乱世之中微弱的正道火光。朝堂肃清、藩镇平定、外寇驱逐，诸多不显山不露水的根基之功，皆出自其手。他如大地磐石，沉默厚重、不离不弃，以一身坚韧铁骨，撑起乱世安邦的底气，以一世默默坚守，护得大魏山河安稳。
四人来路不同、心性各异，性情相悖、行事殊途，本是江湖陌路、山野散人，无半分交集，却因乱世蒙冤、绝境同途，自此羁绊相连、祸福与共。陈尽仇铁血破局，镇乱世刀兵；花无艳智谋定策，解朝堂危局；包不同诤言守正，破世俗虚伪；铁寻柳磐石固守，稳安邦根基。他们曾身陷囹圄、蒙冤受屈，于绝境中挣扎求生；曾直面藩镇铁骑、朝堂权奸，于危局中逆势破局；曾抵御外敌入侵、守护疆土，于乱世中扛起家国重任。布衣之身，无爵禄之赏，无官位之权，却行将相之事、尽社稷之责。
纵观大魏乱世，多少世家权贵、朝堂重臣，手握权柄、坐拥兵马，却只顾私利、罔顾苍生，拱手让山河蒙尘、百姓受难。反观四布衣，起于微末、生于草泽，亲历乱世疾苦，深知生民艰难，故能抛却江湖闲散，以身入局、扶危定倾。他们携手荡平藩镇割据之乱，肃清朝堂宦官外戚之祸，瓦解江湖裹挟朝政之秘势，击退四方窥伺边境之外寇，终令颓败的大魏皇权重归正统，崩坏的社稷重归安稳，流离的百姓重归安居。
乱世既定，山河复安，朝堂清明、四海升平。当世人皆渴求功名、争抢权位之时，四人却初心未改、淡然抽身。他们不恋朝堂荣华，不贪盖世功勋，功成身退、各归本心。陈尽仇收刀藏锋，褪去一身杀伐戾气；花无艳归隐尘外，重归一身澄澈通透；包不同随性江湖，依旧傲骨铮铮、不随俗流；铁寻柳守心自持，依旧沉稳敦厚、初心不改。
大魏百年风云，乱世几多传奇，唯独此四布衣，最是动人。他们以草莽之躯，挽王朝倾覆；以江湖风骨，定天下乾坤；以殊途之心，守同道大义。所谓藏龙隐世，是大能不显、大功不居；所谓覆虎安邦，是勇破乱世、力定山河。这段始于蒙冤、终于归心的乱世传奇，载于岁月、留于青史，见证布衣亦可安社稷，凡人亦可逆乾坤。谨以此序，记大魏中叶乱世风云，记四布衣侠骨忠义，记一场山河为重、本心为终的千古相逢。

content_en:
In the middle of the Wei Dynasty, the illusion of peace collapsed, and the background of the prosperous age faded. The majestic dynasty that has been in existence for hundreds of years cannot escape the fate of a cycle of chaos and falls into the most dangerous predicament in the history of the court. The imperial power gradually weakened, and the emperor was trapped in the deep palace, with only a false reputation and no real ability to control the world. The feudal vassal towns outside the dynasty were established in a separatist regime. Each town's military envoys supported their own self-respect and privately stocked armored troops. They imposed their own taxes and regulations and set their own laws. In the name of the imperial court, in reality, the territory was fragmented, and it was difficult for orders to leave the imperial capital. Factions formed within and outside the court for personal gain, eunuchs monopolized power and disrupted the government. The two factions competed with each other and took turns to take power. The integrity of the court was destroyed, traitors were rampant, loyal people were wronged, and the official system collapsed for decades. There are also secret forces sneaking into the government and the public. The secret forces are colluding with the feudal towns, relying on powerful traitors, and using martial arts undercurrents to threaten the political situation in the court. The boundaries between good and evil are blurred, and public and private grievances are entangled in the interests of the family and the country.
The world is in chaos, temples are decaying, families are following the trend, bureaucrats are living in peace, and those in power are all running for their own selfish interests, and no one cares about the common people of the country. When there is no one in the court to help, and no one in power is loyal, the hope for the survival of the country lies among the common people in the grass. Chen Jinqiu, Hua Wuyan, Bao Tongtong, and Tie Xunliu were originally stragglers in the mountains and rivers and lakes. They had no aristocratic family cover, no official power and responsibilities, and no court foundation. However, they met by chance in the troubled times. Gu Fu will collapse the building, from being wronged and surviving in a desperate situation, to breaking up the chaos, stabilizing the Wei Dynasty, and finally sweeping away the rebellion, suppressing the foreign invaders, and bringing order to the troubled world. Then everyone returns to their true nature and hides in the hustle and bustle, creating an unparalleled legend of hiding the dragon in the world and overthrowing the tiger to stabilize the country.
Chen Jinqiu is a solitary sword born in troubled times, and an iron-blooded minister who stands up in troubled times. In the name of revenge, it is not a desire to kill and hold grudges, or an obsession with personal grudges, but an oath to wipe out all the hatred and hatred in the world and wipe out the injustice in the world. He was originally a loner in the world. He was proud and wandered for half his life. He had no intention of disputes in the court. He did not seek fame or wealth. He only wanted to be free in the world and have a stable heart. But in troubled times, there is no idle person, the common people have no peace, the traitors in the court frame the loyal and the good, the feudal towns slaughter the people, the evil forces in the rivers and lakes help the tyrants to do harm, and countless injustices are buried in the world. He was dragged into the situation due to a shocking injustice, his relatives and friends were in trouble, and he was in danger. From then on, he broke away from the idle world and entered the world with a knife. He is a cold and taciturn person with a tough-as-nails heart. He is used to seeing hypocrisy in court and deceitful people, but he always has the sincerity of his family and country in his heart. He acted swiftly and resolutely, killed with moderation, and distinguished between good and evil. He never tolerated traitors and traitors, and always had compassion for the common people. When there was a rebellion in the feudal town, he rode his horse to quell the rebellion and charged into battle to break the enemy camp; when the powerful traitors were disrupting the government, he went against the trend and drew his sword to kill the traitor Qing Chaotang. He spent all his life fighting for his family and country, and spent half his life fighting for the common people. With his solitary appearance, he broke through the confusion of the troubled times, and with his ambition of revenge, he vindicated the injustice of the Wei Dynasty.
The flowers are not beautiful, but they are a clear pool in the ups and downs of troubled times, and a breeze in the turbulent times. When people look at his name, they mostly think he is gorgeous and flamboyant in the world. Little do they know that the word "wuyan" is a reflection of his original intention to see through the glitz and not be stained by the hustle and bustle of the world. She is proficient in strategy, has insight into people's hearts, and is well versed in the art of court games and the ways of dealing with rivers and lakes, but she has always been indifferent to fame and fortune and does not like disputes. In the troubled times of the court, everyone is vying for power, clinging to the powerful, and all living beings in the world are seeking advantages and avoiding disadvantages, and go with the flow. Only Hua Wuyan keeps her body clear, can see clearly the pros and cons of the situation, and distinguish the true and false of people's hearts. When the four of them travel together, she is the wise eye that breaks the situation and the beacon that leads those who are lost. Countless times of desperate dilemmas, she was the one who strategized and ingeniously solved the situation; countless times of sophistry and power checks and balances in the court, she calmly dealt with and resolved the crisis. She doesn't have a fierce and aggressive attitude, but uses intelligence and gentleness as a blade to resolve swords and calm disputes; she doesn't have a strong and aggressive attitude, but uses a transparent and calm heart to stabilize people's hearts and determine the future. When chaos arose, she used wisdom to stabilize the situation and used kindness to save people., calm the hostility in troubled times, reconcile the differences between the four people, and retain a sense of warmth and clarity for the iron-blooded road to peace.
Bao BuTong is the most rare sober person in troubled times, and a sharp sword for the decadent court. He was unruly and unruly by nature, and refused to follow the trends throughout his life. He refused to follow blindly or follow trends throughout his life. His mantra "No" was consistent throughout his life. He seemed frivolous and stubborn and loved to refute public opinion, but in fact he saw through the hypocrisy of the world and adhered to the right path. At that time, most of the civil and military officials in the court were people who followed the influence of others. They knew clearly that the government's orders were biased and the power was treacherous and harmed the country, but they kept silent and acted wisely to protect themselves. Most of the people in the world were just drifting with the crowd. They saw good and evil reversed and black and white confused, but they all tolerated and gave in and lived in peace. Only Bao Bu is not afraid of powerful people or people's words. He dares to argue when encountering problems and dare to criticize when mistakes are made. He exposes the hypocrisy in the court and refutes the pedantic prejudices of the world. He may seem cynical and undisciplined, but deep down he has the purest loyalty and the most upright character. He disdains secular rules because most of them are set by the powerful and restricts good things; he is unwilling to follow the crowd because most of them are sloppy and have lost their original intention. On the way of the four people to quell the chaos and stabilize the country, he used his lies to break the veil, resisted the powerful with his pride, did not avoid disaster, did not be greedy for merit, and with his unconventional character, he maintained the most rare justice and true heart in troubled times.
Tie Xunliu is the rock barrier in troubled times and the silent backbone of Anbang's destiny. Its name is Tie Xunliu, iron means iron bones and unyielding, Xun means seeking the path, guarding the heart and being unswerving in determination, and willow means pliability and tolerance, adhering to the original intention. He is not as sharp and dazzling as Chen Jinqiu, not as resourceful as Hua Wuyan, and not as maverick as Bao Tongtong, but he is the calmest and most reliable among the four. He has an honest and forbearing temperament, is calm and pragmatic, is not good at words, and does not like to show off. He does not seek fame or praise from the world in his actions throughout his life, but only seeks to be respected and to have eternal peace for his family and country. In wars in troubled times, the road ahead is dangerous and unpredictable, swords and guns are blind, and there are constant storms. Tie Xunliu's figure is present in every charge and every desperate situation. He guards the retreat, stabilizes the foundation, silently carries all the dangers and storms, protects his companions, protects the common people, and protects the weak light of righteousness in troubled times. The court was purged, the vassal towns were pacified, and the foreign invaders were expelled. Many of the basic achievements that were not obvious or obvious were all done by his hands. He is like a rock on the earth, silent and unyielding. With his tough and iron bones, he supports the confidence of peace in troubled times. He silently persists throughout his life and protects the stability of the mountains and rivers of Wei Dynasty.
The four people come from different backgrounds, have different personalities, contradictory temperaments, and act in different ways. They were originally strangers in the world and scattered in the mountains, with no intersection. However, they were wronged due to troubled times and faced the same desperate situation. Chen Jinqiu broke the situation with iron and blood and suppressed the weapons in the troubled times; Hua Wuyan made wise plans and solved the crisis in the court; Bao Tongtong insisted on uprightness and broke the hypocrisy of the world; Tie Xunliu stood firm and stabilized the foundation of the country. They have been imprisoned, wronged and humiliated, and struggled to survive in desperate situations; they have faced the vassal cavalry and the powerful traitors in the court, and bucked the situation in a critical situation; they have resisted the invasion of foreign enemies, protected their territory, and shouldered the important responsibilities of their home and country in troubled times. He is clothed in commoner clothes, has no rewards of rank and salary, and has no power of official position, but he does the work of general and minister and fulfills the responsibilities of the country.
Throughout the troubled times of the Wei Dynasty, many dignitaries and important officials in the court held power and had soldiers and horses, but they only cared about their own interests and ignored the common people, leaving the mountains and rivers covered in dust and the people suffering. On the other hand, Sibuyi started from a young age, was born in a swamp, experienced the sufferings of troubled times, and fully understood the difficulties of living for the people, so he was able to abandon idleness in the world, join the situation with his own body, and help the crisis. They worked together to put an end to the chaos in the feudal towns, eliminate the troubles caused by the eunuchs and their relatives in the court, dismantle the secret power of the rivers and lakes to control the government, and repel the bandits from all sides who were spying on the borders. Finally, the decadent Wei imperial power returned to its orthodoxy, the collapsed society returned to stability, and the displaced people returned to their homes.
The troubled times are settled, the mountains and rivers are restored to peace, the court is clear and the world is peaceful. When everyone in the world is eager for fame and vying for power, the four of them have not changed their original intentions and remain indifferent.Pull away. They are not in love with the glory of the court, nor are they greedy for world-class achievements. They retire after success and return to their true intentions. Chen Jinqiu sheathed his sword and hid his edge, losing his murderous and violent aura; Hua Wuyan returned to the hidden world and returned to a clear and transparent body; Bao Tongtong followed the rivers and lakes, but he was still proud and unconventional; Tie Xunliu kept his heart and remained calm and honest, and his original intention remained unchanged.
The history of the Wei Dynasty has been turbulent for hundreds of years, and there are many legends in the troubled times, but these four commoners are the most touching. With their rough bodies, they saved the dynasty from overthrow; with their character, they determined the world; with their determination to take different paths, they upheld the righteousness of the same people. The so-called hidden dragon hides in the world means that the great power is not revealed and the great achievements are not lived; the so-called overthrowing the tiger and bringing peace to the country means bravely breaking through the troubled times and being able to stabilize the mountains and rivers. This legend of troubled times, which begins with being wronged and finally returns home, has been recorded in the years and remains in history. It proves that commoners can also bring peace to the country, and ordinary people can also turn things around. In this preface, I would like to record the turbulent times in the middle of the Wei Dynasty, the loyalty of the four commoners, and an eternal encounter where mountains and rivers are the most important and true intentions are the end.
